instagram_caption:
Jesus... my brother texted back after two years of silence. Why am I so scared to be happy about it?

It just said "hey, you free Sunday?" Three words. I have read it about forty times and I still do not know what to feel.

"You are afraid to be happy about it, in case it does not hold."

"Then you will have argued face to face instead of across two years of silence. That is already different."

"Good. The speech was for winning. Sunday is not for winning."

"Esau had every reason prepared to hate his brother. He ran anyway. Let your brother see you walking toward him, not waiting with your arms folded."

"But Esau ran to meet Jacob and embraced him; he threw his arms around his neck and kissed him. And they wept."
Genesis 33:4 (NIV)

💬 Is there someone you stopped speaking to? 🙏 Three words can start the walk back.
youtube_title: Jesus, My Brother Texted Back After Two Years 🙏 | Genesis 33:4 #Shorts
youtube_description:
Jesus... my brother texted back after two years of silence. Why am I so scared to be happy about it?

Two years of silence, then three words on a Sunday morning. He does not know whether to hope.

Him: Jesus... my brother texted back after two years of silence. Why am I so scared to be happy about it?

Him: It just said "hey, you free Sunday?" Three words. I have read it about forty times and I still do not know what to feel.

Jesus: You are afraid to be happy about it, in case it does not hold.

Him: What if I show up and we just argue about the same thing all over again?

Jesus: Then you will have argued face to face instead of across two years of silence. That is already different.

Him: I rehearsed what I would say to him for so long. Now my head is completely empty.

Jesus: Good. The speech was for winning. Sunday is not for winning.

Jesus: Esau had every reason prepared to hate his brother. He ran anyway. Let your brother see you walking toward him, not waiting with your arms folded.

"But Esau ran to meet Jacob and embraced him; he threw his arms around his neck and kissed him. And they wept."
Genesis 33:4 (NIV)

Jesus's Replies — the questions you actually ask, answered in His words.

Is there someone you stopped speaking to? 🙏 Three words can start the walk back.
